theorem centered_tail_energy_le_log_budget
    {B A : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
          d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
            ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
              truncatedCenteredRow d
                ((1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ cutoffExponent B A) p m‖ ^ 2) ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 / (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (2 * A) := by
complete_written_declarations.complete_written_body:
let L : ℝ := 1 + Real.log d.scale
  let P : ℕ := 131073 + betaLogExponent B
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)
  have hL : 1 ≤ L := by
    dsimp [L]
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hx]
  have hLpos : 0 < L := zero_lt_one.trans_le hL
  have hH : 0 < L ^ cutoffExponent B A := pow_pos hLpos _
  have hden : L ^ P * L ^ (2 * A) ≤ (L ^ cutoffExponent B A) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_add L P (2 * A), ← pow_mul L (cutoffExponent B A) 2]
    apply pow_le_pow_right₀ hL
    dsimp [P, cutoffExponent]
    omega
  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (m2PolylogConstant_pos B).le (sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ ≤ (CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d) /
        (L ^ cutoffExponent B A) ^ 2 :=
      centered_tail_energy_le_M2 hd (H := L ^ cutoffExponent B A) hH
    _ ≤ (m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 * L ^ P) /
        (L ^ cutoffExponent B A) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog hd hsigma hkappa hcap) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 / L ^ (2 * A) := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hH 2) (pow_pos hLpos (2 * A))).2
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hden hcoefficient

def betaLogExponent (B : ℕ) : ℕ := (2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1

def m2PolylogConstant (B : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  12 * mixedMomentConstant * (2 : ℝ) ^ betaLogExponent B

theorem m2PolylogConstant_pos (B : ℕ) : 0 < m2PolylogConstant B := by

theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (131073 + betaLogExponent B) := by

theorem centered_tail_energy_le_M2
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
          d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
            ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
              truncatedCenteredRow d H p m‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d) / H ^ 2 := by

@[gcongr]
lemma pow_le_pow_right₀ [ZeroLEOneClass M₀] [PosMulMono M₀] (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    a ^ m ≤ a ^ n :=

@[simp] lemma pow_pos [ZeroLEOneClass M₀] (ha : 0 < a) : ∀ n, 0 < a ^ n
  | 0 => by nontriviality; rw [pow_zero]; exact zero_lt_one
  | _ + 1 => pow_succ a _ ▸ mul_pos (pow_pos ha _) ha

lemma div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : a / c ≤ b / c := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv a c, div_eq_mul_inv b c]
  gcongr; exact Right.inv_nonneg.2 hc

lemma div_le_div_iff₀ (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d) : a / b ≤ c / d ↔ a * d ≤ c * b := by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hb, ← mul_div_right_comm, le_div_iff₀ hd]

lemma pow_add (a : M) (m : ℕ) : ∀ n, a ^ (m + n) = a ^ m * a ^ n
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.add_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_succ, Nat.add_assoc]

@[to_additive mul_nsmul] lemma pow_mul (a : M) (m : ℕ) : ∀ n, a ^ (m * n) = (a ^ m) ^ n
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.mul_zero, pow_zero, pow_zero]
  | n + 1 => by rw [Nat.mul_succ, pow_add, pow_succ, pow_mul]

@[bound]
theorem log_nonneg (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ log x :=
  (log_nonneg_iff (zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)).2 hx

@[gcongr]
theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left [PosMulMono α] (hbc : b ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : a * b ≤ a * c :=
  PosMulMono.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hbc

@[gcongr]
theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right [MulPosMono α] (hbc : b ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : b * a ≤ c * a :=
  MulPosMono.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hbc

theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg [PosMulMono α] [MulPosMono α]
    (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : c ≤ d) (a0 : 0 ≤ a) (d0 : 0 ≤ d) : a * c ≤ b * d :=
  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ a0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₁ d0)

theorem mul_le_mul_of_nonneg' [PosMulMono α] [MulPosMono α]
    (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : c ≤ d) (c0 : 0 ≤ c) (b0 : 0 ≤ b) : a * c ≤ b * d :=
  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h₁ c0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ b0)

lemma sq_nonneg [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulMono R] [AddLeftMono R]
    (a : R) : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 := by
  obtain ha | ha := le_or_gt 0 a
  · exact pow_succ_nonneg ha _
